The water writes its slow, reflective prose

And hums the hours until they belong.

It finds the sea the way a word finds rest,
And where it ends, the world begins again—
A delta of beginnings, wide and blessed.

So I have learned to listen to its way,
To let it pull me toward the open shore,
For rivers teach us how to melt delay,
And how to become vast by evermore.
"}
